limitations: This collection holds the HRD circulars announcing the Staff Provident Fund interest rate to EPFO employees (2012 onward). Notices before 2012, and any not listed in the issuer's circulars table, are not included; the gaps (for example 2013-14 to 2016, and 2023-24 Q2) mean the series is not complete.

Each notice states the rate for a financial year or quarter, usually by reproducing the Government of India Budget Division resolution on the General Provident Fund. A later notice revises the rate for its own period; it does not withdraw earlier periods, so no supersession between notices is asserted.

Several circulars are scanned with the Hindi text first; the English subject line and rate sentence are read from the scan and checked on the page, but numeric tables in some scans were not transcribed. Check the rate against the page image.
Three circulars carry their typed letter date instead of the issuer listing date (see the date notes). The rate period each notice applies to is stated in its text, not in its issue date.
The EPF member interest rate is in the EPF interest rate collection, not here.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
